deadline.value: Applications are accepted at any time; the department asks for them two to ten months before the semester starts.
deadline.quote: Your application can be accepted at any time, although new students are accepted only for the Fall and Spring semesters.

also.quote: Please complete the application at least two months and up to 10 months in advance of the start of the semester.

gre_general.value: Required unless you hold a BS or MS in mathematical sciences; other applicants can ask for a case-by-case waiver.
gre_general.quote: GRE test scores are optional for those with MS and BS degrees in mathematical sciences (mathematics, applied mathematics, and statistics); for others it is required, but waivers will be considered on a case-by-case basis.

gre_subject.value: The page does not mention a GRE Mathematics subject test.

supervisor.value: The committee reviews applications as a whole, and the page sets no faculty agreement before admission.
supervisor.quote: There are no GPA, GRE or other scales/cutoffs that we use to accept/disqualify applicants; rather, the committee evaluates holistically the set of skills and experiences applicants bring with them.

funding.value: Most PhD students hold a TA or RA position, but TA and RA places are competitive and limited.
funding.quote: Most PhD students are supported by a TA position.

also.quote: Reviews for admission and for a TA or RA position are separate, with the TA/RA process significantly more competitive due to a very limited number of available spots.

entry_route.value: A BS or an MS in mathematics or a closely related field is accepted.
entry_route.quote: Prerequisites: Students must have a BS (or MS) or equivalent degree(s) in mathematics or a closely related field.

notes: Subject exams (real analysis, computational mathematics, probability and statistics) are internal department exams, not GRE subject tests. New students start only in Fall or Spring.
